name: proxy-admin
title: Proxy Admin
blurb: Dashboard for managing LLM provider credentials and model configuration.
description: A control panel that connects to a proxykit API to display provider status, manage OAuth authentication, refresh tokens, and test LLM models with custom parameters.
use_when: Building an admin interface for LLM gateway configuration, provider auth management, or model testing.
avoid_when: When you don't need API integration or auth flows — this component depends on a live proxykit backend.
a11y: Semantic HTML with buttons, forms, and lists. Uses toast notifications for user feedback.
